t: 国王奥托二世和他的法兰克人军队被al-Qasim的穆斯林军队击败于意大利南部科隆纳角.
te: King Otto II and his Frankish army are defeated by the Muslim army of al-Qasim at Cape Colonna, Southern Italy.

t: 神圣罗马皇帝奥托二世在卡拉布里亚的卡波科隆纳战役被萨拉克人击败.
te: Holy Roman Emperor Otto II is defeated by the Saracens in the Battle of Capo Colonna, in Calabria.
